manual.title: manual
manual.story_content:
Somewhere in the mountains of a land in the east, Hakurei Shrine remains mostly peaceful.

Hakurei Reimu, the shrine maiden, also has plenty of free time. So much free time, in fact, that the shrine's offering income is becoming a serious concern.

Reimu: "Ahh... why isn't there any work, or offerings? At this rate, dinner is going to be tea leaves again."

Just as she was thinking that, a somewhat round figure dropped from the sky.

Marisa: "Yo, Reimu. You still look as skinny as ever."

Reimu: "Hm? This shrine maiden is very serious about body management. Is that so strange?"

In truth, because the shrine's budget was desperately low, Reimu had recently been living an extremely traditional, almost starvation-level diet.

Marisa: "No, that's not the issue. Didn't you notice? Something strange has been happening in Gensokyo lately. Everyone's body has suddenly become heavier, and they have no energy to move. They're sleepy all day."

After hearing that, Reimu looked more carefully at Marisa. Indeed, the usually light-as-a-feather magician looked a little heavier than usual today.

Reimu: "Come to think of it, I haven't seen that regular visitor in a while. Could it be that she's gotten too heavy and is stuck in a gap? We should go find her and get to the bottom of this."

But before that...

Reimu: "Heavier body = can't go outside = nobody comes to the shrine. That's no good. We need lots and lots of offerings! A long-lost job, or rather an incident to solve, sounds exciting!"

Meanwhile...

Marisa: "Hold on. Everyone's gotten lazy lately, and nobody will play danmaku with me. Since we're heading out anyway, how about we warm up, or rather work off a little weight, right here?"

Reimu: "Well, I guess I have no choice. Let's warm up a bit."

And so, the two girls, each with their own motives, one wanting to resolve the incident as quickly as possible, the other simply unable to move properly, began their battle in the shrine's yard.

What will become of the "fatness" law covering this land, the so-called Fat-Hometown Heaven Law?
manual.requirements_content:
Your device needs a modern browser with HTML5 support, such as Chrome, Microsoft Edge on Windows, or Safari on iOS.

The browser should have at least 256 MB of memory available to the JavaScript VM. In real-world testing, the game still runs smoothly with only 128 MB allocated.

For online play, you will also need a stable network. In general, RTT under 80 ms is acceptable; above that, frequent flicker may occur. For LAN play, make sure both devices are on the same subnet and both have Internet access. If you use UDP connection, you must use the desktop app. As long as both IPs can connect directly, you can use UDP without an additional relay.

If you use the desktop app:

Windows: requires the system WebView2 runtime and MSVC components. Windows 10 and 11 usually already have them installed.

macOS: no special setup is needed.

Linux: dependencies vary by distribution. Please follow the Tauri 2.0 runtime requirements for your distro.
manual.gameplay_content:
This is a danmaku battle game. Two players build their battle setup with limited points before fighting until one side is defeated.

You can also play Story Mode, challenge preset loadouts, and uncover the truth behind the incident across several battles.

The hitbox is larger than in typical bullet-hell shooters, so please take care.
manual.controls_content:
Character Select

Selecting characters and ability cards both cost points, so players need to build their battle setup within a limited budget.

A setup must include one primary character and one backup character. During battle, the primary character is used normally; holding Shift switches to the backup character. The two characters share lives, Bombs, and ability cards, but their ammo counts are separate.

During Battle

PC:
- WASD: Move
- Mouse movement: Move the crosshair
- Left click: Shoot (auto fire). Reload when the magazine is empty
- Right click: Use Bomb. If Power reaches 4.00, Bomb consumes Power instead
- E: Use active ability card
- R: Reload. Reload strategy differs by character
- SHIFT: Hold to use the backup character. Some effects prevent switching

Mobile:
- Functions are provided through joysticks and buttons. We recommend testing in the practice range before a real match.
- Unlike on PC, the character-switch button stays active after being pressed and does not need to be held.
manual.items_content:
Neutral enemies drop items when defeated. The game currently has the following item:

- P: Point item, the blue P orb. Picking it up increases power. The amount gained depends on its size.

You can also increase power by grazing bullets.

Power improves your shooting capabilities, such as bullet count and bullet patterns. It starts at 1.00 and caps at 4.00, with each 1.00 threshold increasing firepower.
